key_insight: Actinic keratosis labeling affected NIR skin-lesion classification more than classifier choice, while single-band importance was unstable.
clinical_relevance: This skin-lesion triage study—not drug discovery—highlights why label definitions matter when interpreting AI performance.
method: Analyzed 714 in vivo NIR spectra from 331 patients with standard normal variate normalization.
Compared five classifiers using nested, patient-separated cross-validation across alternative actinic keratosis labelings.
Assessed band-importance stability with 60 patient-level bootstrap resamples and band-removal tests.
evidence_signal: On the standard binary task, SVM achieved ROC-AUC 0.842 ± 0.006; macro-F1 fell from 0.764 with actinic keratosis labeled non-cancer to 0.677 when labeled positive.
watch_item: The supplied abstract is truncated, and its single-dataset evaluation does not establish external clinical generalizability.
paper_title: Actinic keratosis labeling and single-band instability in near-infrared spectroscopy of skin cancer: a nested, patient-level re-analysis
